Description

Adrenaline and noradrenaline activate β2 adrenoceptors on nociceptors. Through Gs, adenylate cyclase and protein kinase A, they lower the threshold of the nerve endings and cause mechanical hyperalgesia. People with low COMT activity, who clear catecholamines more slowly, are more sensitive to pain, including OA pain.

Colour

Each block is coloured by its effect on pain, red where it raises pain and blue where it relieves it, and everything in it takes that colour, GTP and GDP included, as it works for the block's result. Drugs are yellow and classes of molecules white.

This block is red: through β2 and Gs, noradrenaline sensitises nociceptors.
